Additional Resources:
CCFP Cooperative Agreement NOFO
The Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) pre-recorded a funding
conference webinar for the following Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) posted on
Grants.gov:
• Crash Causal Factors Program (CCFP) Cooperative Agreement
To access this pre-recording, please visit:
https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/fy26grantfundingopportunities
FMCSA will also host a live Office Hours session on Thursday, November 12,
11am─12pm EST. Registration is required. Please register for this session here:
https://usdot.zoomgov.com/meeting/register/Xqh_yEXmRcS307zXDBNuZQ
Important Guidelines for the Office Hours Session
To ensure fairness and consistency for all applicants, FMCSA staff will adhere to the
following boundaries:
• Staff can clarify information included in the NOFO.
• Staff cannot assist with application development, including reviewing or editing
proposal language.
• Questions related specifically to eligibility should be submitted via email to the
appropriate grant program managers; these will be addressed outside of the live
sessions.
If you have not viewed the FMCSA Discretionary Grant Program Technical Assistance
webinars, please view at: https://www.fmcsa.dot.gov/grantswebinars to assist with
preparing an application. These webinars were developed for other FMCSA discretionary
grants, but the process is very similar for the CCFP Cooperative Agreement Program.
Please note that participants should fully read the NOFO before the live Office Hours
session to familiarize themselves with the current and relevant information.
FMCSA looks forward to addressing your questions.
